下面提供一套较为全面的 MySQL 练习题，包括题目描述、参考答案（SQL 语句）以及示例数据的建表 SQL。通过这些题目，你可以练习常见的增删改查、条件查询、分组、排序、多表连接、子查询、HAVING、统计以及行转列等操作。

一、示例数据建表 SQL

首先创建两个示例表：一个是 departments（部门表），另一个是 employees（员工表），二者通过部门 ID 建立关联。你也可以根据需要扩充数据量和字段。

sql
-- 创建部门表
CREATE TABLE departments (
  dept_id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  dept_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL
);

-- 创建员工表
CREATE TABLE employees (
  emp_id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  emp_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  dept_id INT,
  salary DECIMAL(10,2),
  join_date DATE,
  FOREIGN KEY (dept_id) REFERENCES departments(dept_id)
);

接下来插入一些示例数据：

sql

二、练习题及答案

题目 1：基础 CRUD 操作

要求：

  1. 插入一条新员工记录。
  2. 更新某个员工的工资。
  3. 删除一条员工记录。
  4. 查询所有员工数据。

参考答案：

sql
-- 1. 插入一条新记录
INSERT INTO employees (emp_name, dept_id, salary, join_date)
VALUES ('Ivan', 2, 6700, '2022-03-15');

-- 2. 更新员工工资（将 emp_id = 2 的员工工资调整为5800）
UPDATE employees
SET salary = 5800
WHERE emp_id = 2;

-- 3. 删除一条记录（删除 emp_id = 8 的员工）
DELETE FROM employees
WHERE emp_id = 8;

-- 4. 查询所有员工
SELECT * FROM employees;

题目 2：条件查询与排序

要求： 查询工资大于 5000 的员工，并按工资降序排列。

参考答案：

sql
SELECT emp_id, emp_name, salary
FROM employees
WHERE salary > 5000
ORDER BY salary DESC;

题目 3：分组查询

要求： 按部门分组，计算每个部门的平均工资。

参考答案：

sql
SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name;

题目 4：多字段分组排序

要求：

  1. 按部门分组，统计每个部门的员工数和平均工资；
  2. 按平均工资降序排列；
  3. 同时在每个部门内部按工资降序显示员工详细信息（可拆分为两步）。

参考答案：

步骤 1：部门汇总

sql
SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(*) AS emp_count, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name
ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;

步骤 2：部门内部排序

sql
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_name, d.dept_name, e.salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
ORDER BY d.dept_name, e.salary DESC;

题目 5：HAVING 统计

要求： 查询员工人数大于 2 的部门，并显示部门名称及员工人数。

参考答案：

sql
SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(*) AS emp_count
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

题目 6：多表连接查询

要求： 列出所有员工的姓名、所属部门名称和工资。

参考答案：

sql
SELECT e.emp_name, d.dept_name, e.salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id;

题目 7：子查询练习

要求： 查询工资高于所在部门平均工资的员工姓名及其工资。

参考答案：

sql
SELECT emp_name, salary
FROM employees
WHERE salary > (
  SELECT AVG(salary)
  FROM employees AS e2
  WHERE e2.dept_id = employees.dept_id
);

题目 8：聚合统计

要求： 按部门统计员工数量，并显示部门名称与对应人数。

参考答案：

sql
SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS emp_count
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name;

题目 9：行转列（Pivot 表）

要求： 将每个部门的总工资（SUM(salary)）转为行转列显示，结果中每个部门一列，显示所有部门的总工资合计。

参考答案：

假设部门较少，可以使用 CASE WHEN 方式实现：

sql
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN dept_id = 1 THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS Sales_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dept_id = 2 THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS Marketing_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dept_id = 3 THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS HR_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dept_id = 4 THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS IT_total
FROM employees;

如果部门动态较多，可考虑在应用层进行转置，或者使用存储过程、动态 SQL 等方式实现。

题目 10：综合练习

要求： 对每个部门，查询：

  • 员工总数；
  • 平均工资、最高工资、最低工资；
  • 同时列出工资高于该部门平均工资的员工姓名和工资。

参考答案：

步骤 1：部门统计

sql
SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS emp_count,
       AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary,
       MAX(e.salary) AS max_salary,
       MIN(e.salary) AS min_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name;

步骤 2：部门内高于平均工资的员工

sql
SELECT e.emp_name, d.dept_name, e.salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
WHERE e.salary > (
  SELECT AVG(e2.salary)
  FROM employees e2
  WHERE e2.dept_id = e.dept_id
)
ORDER BY d.dept_name, e.salary DESC;

通过以上练习题，你可以较全面地练习 MySQL 的各种查询与数据处理操作。可以根据实际情况调整数据和题目难度，进一步深入学习 SQL 各项功能。

二、100 道 MySQL 练习题

下面的题目按照不同主题组织，每题均给出题目描述和参考答案。你可以依次练习和验证。

【基础 CRUD 操作】

  1. 插入新员工记录
    题目： 向 employees 表中插入一条记录：emp_name 为 'Kevin'，dept_id 为 3，salary 为 5300，join_date 为 '2022-05-10'。
    答案：

    sql
    INSERT INTO employees (emp_name, dept_id, salary, join_date)
VALUES ('Kevin', 3, 5300, '2022-05-10');

  2. 更新员工工资
    题目： 将 emp_id=2 的员工工资更新为 5800。
    答案：

    sql
    UPDATE employees
SET salary = 5800
WHERE emp_id = 2;

  3. 删除员工记录
    题目： 删除 emp_id=8 的员工。
    答案：

    sql
    DELETE FROM employees
WHERE emp_id = 8;

  4. 查询所有员工记录

    答案：

    sql
    SELECT * FROM employees;

    题目： 向 departments 表中插入一个新部门 'Operations'。
    答案：

    sql
    INSERT INTO departments (dept_name)
VALUES ('Operations');

  6. 更新部门名称
    题目： 将部门 'Finance' 的名称更新为 'Financial Services'。
    答案：

    sql
    UPDATE departments
SET dept_name = 'Financial Services'
WHERE dept_name = 'Finance';

  7. 删除部门记录
    题目： 删除部门名称为 'Marketing' 的记录（注意外键约束可能需要先处理相关员工记录）。
    答案：

    sql
    DELETE FROM departments
WHERE dept_name = 'Marketing';

  8. 查询所有部门
    题目： 查询所有部门信息。
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT * FROM departments;

  9. 插入新产品
    题目： 向 products 表中插入一个新产品：'Printer'，价格为 980。
    答案：

    sql
    INSERT INTO products (product_name, price)
VALUES ('Printer', 980);

  10. 更新产品价格
    题目： 将产品 'Monitor' 的价格更新为 1300。
    答案：

    sql
    UPDATE products
SET price = 1300
WHERE product_name = 'Monitor';

【基本 SELECT 查询与条件】

  1. 查询工资大于 5000 的员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, salary
FROM employees
WHERE salary > 5000;

  2. 查询入职日期在 2020 之后的员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, join_date
FROM employees
WHERE join_date > '2020-01-01';

    答案：

    sql
    SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_name, d.dept_name

JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id

  4. 查询价格在 100 到 500 之间的产品
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT product_id, product_name, price

WHERE price BETWEEN 100 AND 500;

    答案：

    sql
    SELECT order_id, total_amount
FROM orders

  6. 查询客户来自 'Beijing' 的客户
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT customer_id, customer_name, region

    答案：

    sql

    答案：

    sql

FROM orders

  9. 查询产品价格不为空的记录
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT product_id, product_name, price
FROM products
WHERE price IS NOT NULL;
``>

  10. 查询员工姓名及其部门名称（简单连接）
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT e.emp_name, d.dept_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id;

【排序与限制】

  1. 按工资降序查询所有员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY salary DESC;

  2. 按订单日期升序查询所有订单
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT order_id, order_date, total_amount
FROM orders
ORDER BY order_date ASC;

  3. 查询最新入职的 5 个员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, join_date
FROM employees
ORDER BY join_date DESC
LIMIT 5;

  4. 查询工资最高的员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY salary DESC
LIMIT 1;

  5. 查询每个部门中工资最高的员工（子查询方式）
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, dept_id, salary
FROM employees e1
WHERE salary = (
  SELECT MAX(salary)
  FROM employees e2
  WHERE e2.dept_id = e1.dept_id
);

  6. 按价格降序查询所有产品
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT product_id, product_name, price
FROM products
ORDER BY price DESC;

  7. 查询订单总额前 3 高的订单
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT order_id, total_amount
FROM orders
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

  8. 按客户名称字母顺序排序查询客户
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT customer_id, customer_name, region
FROM customers
ORDER BY customer_name ASC;

  9. 按部门名称倒序查询所有部门
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, dept_name
FROM departments
ORDER BY dept_name DESC;

  10. 查询最新的订单记录
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT order_id, order_date, total_amount
FROM orders
ORDER BY order_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

【分组与聚合函数】

  1. 按部门统计员工数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, COUNT(*) AS emp_count
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id;

  2. 按部门计算平均工资
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id;

  3. 统计每个产品在订单明细中的出现次数
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM order_details
GROUP BY product_id;

  4. 按客户分组统计订单总额
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id;

  5. 按部门分组求最大工资
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, MAX(salary) AS max_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id;

  6. 统计每个地区的客户数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
GROUP BY region;

  7. 统计每个部门的总工资
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, SUM(salary) AS total_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id;

  8. 统计每个产品的销售总额（数量×单价）
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM order_details
GROUP BY product_id;

  9. 按订单分组统计订单明细数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS detail_count
FROM order_details
GROUP BY order_id;

  10. 按月份统计订单数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_month;

【多表连接查询】

  1. 查询所有员工的姓名及其部门名称
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT e.emp_name, d.dept_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id;

  2. 查询所有订单及对应客户名称
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.customer_name
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id;

  3. 查询订单明细中每条记录的产品名称
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT od.order_detail_id, p.product_name, od.quantity
FROM order_details od
JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id;

  4. 查询每个订单的详细产品信息
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT o.order_id, p.product_name, od.quantity, od.unit_price
FROM orders o
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id;

  5. 查询员工及其所属部门的详细信息
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT e.*, d.dept_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id;

  6. 查询客户及其所有订单信息
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT c.customer_name, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

  7. 查询每个部门及该部门所有员工信息
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT d.dept_name, e.emp_id, e.emp_name, e.salary
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id
ORDER BY d.dept_name;

  8. 查询订单及订单明细中的产品名称和数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT o.order_id, p.product_name, od.quantity
FROM orders o
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id;

  9. 查询每个客户的最新订单信息
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT o1.order_id, o1.customer_id, o1.order_date, o1.total_amount
FROM orders o1
WHERE o1.order_date = (
  SELECT MAX(o2.order_date)
  FROM orders o2
  WHERE o2.customer_id = o1.customer_id
);

  10. 查询每个产品在订单中的出现次数
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(od.order_detail_id) AS appear_count
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name;

【子查询练习】

  1. 查询工资高于公司平均工资的员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, salary
FROM employees
WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees);

  2. 查询入职日期早于公司平均入职日期的员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, join_date
FROM employees
WHERE join_date < (SELECT AVG(join_date) FROM (SELECT join_date FROM employees) AS t);

    注意：日期的平均值计算需转换，实际使用时可采用其他方式。

  3. 查询订单总额大于所有订单平均总额的订单
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT order_id, total_amount
FROM orders
WHERE total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders);

  4. 查询销售额高于平均销售额的产品
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT product_id, 
       SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM order_details
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING total_sales > (
  SELECT AVG(t.total_sales) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_sales
    FROM order_details
    GROUP BY product_id
  ) t
);

  5. 查询订单总额高于客户平均订单总额的客户
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS customer_total
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING customer_total > (
  SELECT AVG(t.total) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
  ) t
);

  6. 查询每个部门中工资最高的员工（子查询方式）
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, dept_id, salary
FROM employees e
WHERE salary = (
  SELECT MAX(salary)
  FROM employees
  WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id
);

  7. 查询全公司中工资最低的员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, salary
FROM employees
WHERE salary = (SELECT MIN(salary) FROM employees);

  8. 查询订单中总金额最低的订单
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT order_id, total_amount
FROM orders
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MIN(total_amount) FROM orders);

  9. 查询每个部门中入职最早的员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT emp_id, emp_name, dept_id, join_date
FROM employees e
WHERE join_date = (
  SELECT MIN(join_date)
  FROM employees
  WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id
);
``>

  10. 查询产品价格低于全体产品平均价格的产品
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT product_id, product_name, price
FROM products
WHERE price < (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products);

【多字段分组排序】

  1. 按部门和入职年份分组统计员工数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, YEAR(join_date) AS join_year, COUNT(*) AS emp_count
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id, YEAR(join_date);

  2. 按部门分组统计总工资，并按总工资降序排序
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, SUM(salary) AS total_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id
ORDER BY total_salary DESC;

  3. 按客户和订单月份分组统计订单数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT customer_id, DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id, order_month;

  4. 按产品和订单月份分组统计销售数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT od.product_id, DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, SUM(od.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM order_details od
JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY od.product_id, order_month;

  5. 按部门和入职月份分组计算平均工资
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, DATE_FORMAT(join_date, '%Y-%m') AS join_month, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id, join_month;

【HAVING 子句】

  1. 查询员工数量大于 3 的部门
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, COUNT(*) AS emp_count
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id
HAVING emp_count > 3;

  2. 查询平均工资超过 6000 的部门
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id
HAVING avg_salary > 6000;

  3. 查询订单数量超过 1 的客户
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING order_count > 1;

  4. 查询销售总额超过 10000 的产品
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM order_details
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING total_sales > 10000;

  5. 查询每个月订单总金额大于 5000 的月份
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, SUM(total_amount) AS month_total
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_month
HAVING month_total > 5000;

【统计与计算】

  1. 计算公司所有员工的总工资
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT SUM(salary) AS company_total_salary
FROM employees;

  2. 计算所有订单的总销售额
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM orders;

  3. 计算产品的平均价格
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT AVG(price) AS avg_price
FROM products;
``>

  4. 计算每个部门员工工资的标准差
    答案：
    （注：MySQL 5.7+ 可使用 STD() 函数）

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, STD(salary) AS salary_std
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id;

  5. 计算每个客户订单的平均订单金额
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT customer_id, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id;
``>

【行转列 (Pivot)】

  1. 将各部门的总工资转为列显示
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN dept_id = 1 THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS Sales_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dept_id = 2 THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS Marketing_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dept_id = 3 THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS HR_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dept_id = 4 THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS IT_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dept_id = 5 THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS Financial_total
FROM employees;

  2. 将每个月的订单总额转为列显示
    答案：
    （假设固定几个月，如 '2021-01', '2021-03', '2021-05' 等）

    sql
    SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2021-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS '2021-01',
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2021-03' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS '2021-03',
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2021-05' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS '2021-05'
FROM orders;

  3. 将每个客户的订单总额转为列显示
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id = 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS Customer1_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id = 2 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS Customer2_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id = 3 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS Customer3_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id = 4 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS Customer4_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id = 5 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS Customer5_total
FROM orders;

  4. 将每个产品的销售数量按月份转为列显示
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT
  product_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2021-01' THEN od.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS '2021-01',
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2021-03' THEN od.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS '2021-03'
FROM order_details od
JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY product_id;

  5. 将每个部门的员工数量按入职年份转为列显示
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT
  dept_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(join_date)=2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '2018',
  SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(join_date)=2019 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '2019',
  SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(join_date)=2020 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '2020',
  SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(join_date)=2021 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '2021'
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id;

【综合复杂查询】

  1. 查询每个部门的员工总数、平均工资、最高工资、最低工资
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS emp_count,
       AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary,
       MAX(e.salary) AS max_salary,
       MIN(e.salary) AS min_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name;

  2. 查询每个部门中工资高于该部门平均工资的员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT e.emp_name, d.dept_name, e.salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
WHERE e.salary > (
  SELECT AVG(salary)
  FROM employees
  WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id
);

  3. 查询每个客户最新的订单详情
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT o1.*
FROM orders o1
WHERE o1.order_date = (
  SELECT MAX(o2.order_date)
  FROM orders o2
  WHERE o2.customer_id = o1.customer_id
);

  4. 查询订单总额排名前 5 的订单及其客户信息
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT o.order_id, o.total_amount, c.customer_name
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

  5. 查询产品销售额排名前 3 的产品
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.quantity * od.unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM order_details od
JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 3;

  6. 查询订单总额大于所有客户平均订单总额的客户
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS customer_total
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_name
HAVING customer_total > (
  SELECT AVG(t.total) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
  ) t
);

  7. 查询每个部门中入职最早和最晚的员工
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id,
       MIN(join_date) AS earliest_join,
       MAX(join_date) AS latest_join
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id;

  8. 查询销售数量超过平均销售数量的产品
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM order_details
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING total_quantity > (
  SELECT AVG(t.total_qty) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_qty
    FROM order_details
    GROUP BY product_id
  ) t
);

  9. 查询每个客户的订单数量及订单总金额
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_name;
``>

  10. 查询每个订单的产品明细和数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT o.order_id, p.product_name, od.quantity
FROM orders o
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id;

  11. 查询各部门员工的平均工资和总工资，并显示部门名称
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary, SUM(e.salary) AS total_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name;

  12. 查询订单总额最高的前 3 个客户
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

  13. 查询 2021 年下单的所有订单及对应客户名称
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.customer_name
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE YEAR(o.order_date) = 2021;

  14. 查询每个产品的累计销售数量和累计销售额
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT p.product_name, 
       SUM(od.quantity) AS total_quantity,
       SUM(od.quantity * od.unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM products p
JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name;

  15. 查询每个部门中工资最高员工的详细信息
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT e.*
FROM employees e
WHERE (e.dept_id, e.salary) IN (
  SELECT dept_id, MAX(salary)
  FROM employees
  GROUP BY dept_id
);

  16. 统计每年各部门新增员工数量
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT dept_id, YEAR(join_date) AS join_year, COUNT(*) AS new_emp_count
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id, YEAR(join_date);

  17. 查询每个订单中产品的销售额
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS order_sales
FROM order_details
GROUP BY order_id;

  18. 查询所有客户订单的平均订单金额及标准差
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order, STD(total_amount) AS std_order
FROM orders;

  19. 查询每个员工工资与所属部门平均工资之差
    答案：

    sql
    SELECT e.emp_name, e.salary,
       e.salary - (
         SELECT AVG(salary)
         FROM employees
         WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id
       ) AS diff_from_dept_avg
FROM employees e;

  20. 查询每个产品在每个月的销售数量，并要求行转列显示
    答案： sql SELECT product_id, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2021-01' THEN od.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS '2021-01', SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2021-03' THEN od.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS '2021-03', SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2021-05' THEN od.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS '2021-05' FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY product_id;
